Use when implementing or refactoring frontend UI.</p> <p><strong>Skill text begins.</strong> Save as <code>web-a11y-authoring/SKILL.md</code>.</p> <h4 id="web-a11y-authoring-1">Web A11y Authoring</h4> <h5 id="core-rules">Core Rules</h5> <p>For concrete markup patterns, see <a href="PATTERNS.md">PATTERNS.md</a>.</p> <ol type="1"> <li>Prefer native HTML controls before ARIA or custom widgets.</li> <li>Use links for navigation and buttons for actions.</li> <li>Ensure every interactive control has a clear accessible name.</li> <li>Keep DOM order aligned with reading and interaction order.</li> <li>Preserve visible focus and keyboard operation for every interaction.</li> <li>Use ARIA only to supplement semantics that cannot be expressed natively.</li> <li>Classify images, icons, and SVG as decorative, informative, or functional.</li> <li>Communicate unusual link behavior before activation.</li> </ol> <h5 id="authoring-checklist">Authoring Checklist</h5> <div class="sourceCode" id="cb794"><pre class="sourceCode markdown"><code class="sourceCode markdown"><span id="cb794-1"><a href="#cb794-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>Authoring checklist</span> <span id="cb794-2"><a href="#cb794-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span> <span id="cb794-3"><a href="#cb794-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Page has meaningful title, language, landmarks, and heading structure</span> <span id="cb794-4"><a href="#cb794-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Controls expose role, name, state, and value correctly</span> <span id="cb794-5"><a href="#cb794-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Interactions work with keyboard alone</span> <span id="cb794-6"><a href="#cb794-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Focus is visible, logical, and intentionally managed</span> <span id="cb794-7"><a href="#cb794-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Hidden content is not accidentally focusable or announced</span> <span id="cb794-8"><a href="#cb794-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Native control behavior is preserved under custom styling</span> <span id="cb794-9"><a href="#cb794-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Links describe destination/action, including downloads and context changes</span> <span id="cb794-10"><a href="#cb794-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Images, SVG, and icons have appropriate text alternatives or are hidden correctly</span> <span id="cb794-11"><a href="#cb794-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Audio/video has controls and alternatives such as captions or transcripts when needed</span></code></pre></div> <h5 id="common-patterns">Common Patterns</h5> <ul> <li>Toggle button: native <code>button</code> with synchronized state such as <code>aria-pressed</code>.</li> <li>Disclosure: button with synchronized <code>aria-expanded</code> and hidden content state.</li> <li>Dialog: intentional initial focus, contained interaction while open, focus restored on close.</li> <li>Icon-only control: visible or programmatic accessible name that describes the action.</li> <li>Download/file link: link text includes action, target, file type, and size when useful.</li> <li>Functional image/SVG: accessible name describes the action or destination.</li> <li>Decorative image/SVG: removed from the accessibility tree without hiding useful text.</li> <li>Media: avoid disruptive autoplay, provide controls, and include captions/transcripts when content requires them.</li> </ul> <h5 id="output-9">Output</h5> <p>Describe semantic choices, ARIA states used, non-text content decisions, keyboard behavior, and manual test plan.</p> <p><strong>Skill text ends.</strong></p> <h3 id="web-a11y-css">Web A11y CSS</h3> <ul> <li><strong>License:</strong> MIT</li> <li><strong>Name:</strong> <code>web-a11y-css</code></li> <li><strong>Publisher:</strong> Axel (klovaaxel)</li> <li><strong>Repository:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/klovaaxel/web-a11y-agent-skills">klovaaxel/web-a11y-agent-skills</a></li> <li><strong>Source:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/klovaaxel/web-a11y-agent-skills/tree/15fa84624b15ec8823f88c176ce11eb9c0f24c29/skills/web-a11y-css">skills/web-a11y-css</a></li> </ul> <p>Reviews and writes CSS that preserves accessibility across contrast, focus styles, reduced motion, forced colors, zoom, target size, semantic integrity, and custom-styled controls. Use for UI styling and design-system changes.</p> <p><strong>Skill text begins.</strong> Save as <code>web-a11y-css/SKILL.md</code>.</p> <h4 id="web-a11y-css-1">Web A11y CSS</h4> <h5 id="css-rules">CSS Rules</h5> <ol type="1"> <li>Do not remove focus indicators without a visible replacement.</li> <li>Do not rely on color alone for meaning.</li> <li>Respect reduced motion and provide user control for moving content.</li> <li>Preserve usability under zoom, reflow, large text, and forced-colors modes.</li> <li>Avoid CSS that breaks semantics or operability.</li> </ol> <h5 id="risky-css-checklist">Risky CSS Checklist</h5> <div class="sourceCode" id="cb795"><pre class="sourceCode markdown"><code class="sourceCode markdown"><span id="cb795-1"><a href="#cb795-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>CSS accessibility checklist</span> <span id="cb795-2"><a href="#cb795-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span> <span id="cb795-3"><a href="#cb795-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Focus styles are visible and high contrast</span> <span id="cb795-4"><a href="#cb795-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Text, controls, and states meet contrast expectations</span> <span id="cb795-5"><a href="#cb795-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Target sizes and spacing support touch and motor constraints</span> <span id="cb795-6"><a href="#cb795-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Motion is reduced or disabled when users request it</span> <span id="cb795-7"><a href="#cb795-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> <span class="in">`display`</span>, <span class="in">`visibility`</span>, <span class="in">`content-visibility`</span>, and <span class="in">`pointer-events`</span> do not break semantics</span> <span id="cb795-8"><a href="#cb795-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Hidden <li><strong>Name:</strong> <code>web-a11y-dynamic-ui</code></li> <li><strong>Publisher:</strong> Axel (klovaaxel)</li> <li><strong>Repository:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/klovaaxel/web-a11y-agent-skills">klovaaxel/web-a11y-agent-skills</a></li> <li><strong>Source:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/klovaaxel/web-a11y-agent-skills/tree/15fa84624b15ec8823f88c176ce11eb9c0f24c29/skills/web-a11y-dynamic-ui">skills/web-a11y-dynamic-ui</a></li> </ul> <p>Handles accessible dynamic interfaces such as filtering, sorting, pagination, progress, live regions, status messages, data tables, and client-rendered result updates. Use when UI changes without a full page load.</p> <p><strong>Skill text begins.</strong> Save as <code>web-a11y-dynamic-ui/SKILL.md</code>.</p> <h4 id="web-a11y-dynamic-ui-1">Web A11y Dynamic UI</h4> <h5 id="rules-2">Rules</h5> <ol type="1"> <li>Client-side updates need non-visual feedback.</li> <li>Use live regions for status updates that should not move focus.</li> <li>Move focus only when it improves task flow and orientation.</li> <li>Use table semantics for tabular relationships, not layout.</li> <li>Communicate sort, current page, result count, and progress state semantically and visually.</li> </ol> <h5 id="checklist-6">Checklist</h5> <div class="sourceCode" id="cb796"><pre class="sourceCode markdown"><code class="sourceCode markdown"><span id="cb796-1"><a href="#cb796-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>Dynamic UI checklist</span> <span id="cb796-2"><a href="#cb796-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span> <span id="cb796-3"><a href="#cb796-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Active filters and result counts are discoverable</span> <span id="cb796-4"><a href="#cb796-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Loading, empty, error, and success states are announced when needed</span> <span id="cb796-5"><a href="#cb796-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Pagination exposes current page and available movement</span> <span id="cb796-6"><a href="#cb796-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Progress indicators expose current step/value where meaningful</span> <span id="cb796-7"><a href="#cb796-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Tables have captions or labels, headers, and sort state</span> <span id="cb796-8"><a href="#cb796-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ss">- </span><span class="va">[ ]</span> Interactive controls inside data views preserve context</span></code></pre></div> <h5
